text: The README defines common flags (`--json`, `--output`, `--non-interactive`, `--fields`, `--limit`, `--offset`, `--strict`, `--profile`, `--mode`, `--changed`), a JSON return envelope with `schema_version`, `command`, `status`, `run_id`, `data`, `errors`, `warnings`, and `metrics`, streamed list behavior for `--output jsonl`, exit codes `0`, `1`, and `64`, and `og --version` alignment between source checkouts and packaged installs.
